gloss: roughly; more or less; once through

definitions.gloss: roughly; more or less; in general
definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something to a basic or general degree without going into great depth or detail.

definitions.gloss: once through; from beginning to end
definitions.explanation: Indicates going through something completely once, covering all items or steps.

notes:
An extremely common adverb meaning to do something to a general degree or to go through something once completely. The two senses overlap — both involve covering something without exhaustive depth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一通|ひととお}り⟦{目|め}を{通|とお}す→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧: to look through (a document) once
- {一通|ひととお}り⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain roughly
- {一通|ひととお}り⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to do (something) more or less
- {一通|ひととお}り{終|お}わる: to finish going through everything
- {一通|ひととお}り⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: to have a basic set of everything

USAGE:
Sense 1 often appears with verbs of ability ({一通|ひととお}り⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧) to indicate general competence. Sense 2 often pairs with verbs of checking or reviewing to indicate covering all items.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ざっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: more casual; emphasizes speed and roughness
- だいたい: focuses on approximation rather than coverage
- ひと{通|とお}り: same word, alternate kanji rendering
